title: The console's top menu folds up while you scroll down

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21 in the project thread: make the sub menu up top fold up when still.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. READING: the owner said fold up when still; read as: the sub menu across the top tucks away while a page scrolls down and slides back on any scroll up, at the top of the page, or when the pointer moves into the top strip. AdminTopMenu (components/frequency/admin/admin-nav.tsx) sets data-fold from foldAfterScroll (nav-model.ts, pure, with a 6 px slack so trackpad jitter does not flicker it). The CSS folds it only on a wide screen (961 px and up), never while focus is inside it, and under reduced motion the duration tokens are zero so it simply appears or goes. On a phone it never folds, because that strip is the only place the active page shows. Only the operator console has a top menu; the Space console's pages sit under the active row of its sidebar and on a phone in the same strip, so it has nothing to fold on a wide screen.

verify.note: Fails when the fold rule, the hook, the attribute on either layout, the pointer return, the wide-screen and focus guards or the duration tokens go.
